verdict.rationale: A government tax portal could plausibly publish a documented public API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only web-portal services: login spaces, online payment, simulators, forms and a 'Statistiques et Données' page. None of it documents a public API that a user or agent could use to drive the product programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
